Collect all SG references referenced_sgs = set() for child_module in state['values']['root_module'].get('child_modules', []): for resource in child_module.get('resources', []): if resource['type'] == 'aws_instance': vpc_sgs = resource['values'].get('vpc_security_group_ids', []) if vpc_sgs: for sg in vpc_sgs: if sg and sg != 'sg-default' and sg != 'default': referenced_sgs.add(sg) elif resource['type'] == 'aws_launch_template': sgs = resource['values'].get('security_groups', []) if sgs: for sg in sgs: if sg: referenced_sgs.add(sg) # Group by region if available in tags by_region = {} for sg_id, sg_info in unused_sgs.items(): # Try to extract region from name or tags name = sg_info['name'] # Try to infer region from name pattern if 'us-east-1' in name: region = 'us-east-1' elif 'us-west-1' in name: region = 'us-west-1' elif 'us-west-2' in name: region = 'us-west-2' elif 'eu-west-1' in name: region = 'eu-west-1' else: region = 'unknown' if region not in by_region: by_region[region] = [] by_region[region].append((sg_id, sg_info)) for region in sorted(by_region.keys()): print(f"Region: {region}") print("-" * 80) for sg_id, sg_info in by_region[region]: print(f" ID: {sg_id}") print(f" Name: {sg_info['name']}") print(f" VPC ID: {sg_info['vpc_id']}") print(f" Module: {sg_info['module']}") print(f" Address: {sg_info['address']}") print() else: print("No unused security groups found!") print() print("=" * 80) print("SUMMARY") print("=" * 80) if unused_sgs: print(f"\n{len(unused_sgs)} unused security group(s) detected:") for sg_id in sorted(unused_sgs.keys()): print(f" - {sg_id}: {unused_sgs[sg_id]['name']}") else: print("All managed security groups are in use.")
